  - A new line was added to call `GHUser.wrap(users, root);`, which wraps the returned user objects with the `root` reference. This allows the user objects to populate themselves with complete data, preventing potential `NullPointerException` when accessing methods like `user.getCreatedAt()`.

### Relationships Between Modifications
The modification in `GHOrganization.java` directly addresses a bug introduced in a previous pull request (PR #66). The change ensures that the `getMembers()` method, which now uses paging, retains the functionality to fully populate user objects. By wrapping the returned users with the `root` reference, the patch resolves the issue of incomplete user data being returned, thus enhancing the robustness of the method and preventing runtime exceptions.
